id: \bCissy uses Water Pokémon for her Gym.
en: \bCissy uses Water Pokémon for her Gym.
it: \bNella sua Palestra Cissy usa Pokémon di tipo Acqua.
Ho detto di smetterla di guardare.
\rIl mio costume da bagno è un po' imbarazzante.

id: \rCissy: Hi there! Are you ready to be demolished by a member of the Orange Crew?
en: \rCissy: Hi there! Are you ready to be demolished by a member of the Orange Crew?
it: \rCissy: Ciao! Sei pronto a farti demolire da un membro degli Orange Crew?
\rCissy: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Occhio di Corallo.

id: \rTM18 contains Rain Dance. Rain Dance makes it rain for a few turns, boosting the power of Water moves.
en: \rTM18 contains Rain Dance. Rain Dance makes it rain for a few turns, boosting the power of Water moves.
it: \rLa MT18 contiene Pioggiadanza. Pioggiadanza fa piovere per alcuni turni, aumentando la potenza delle mosse di tipo Acqua.

id: \rCissy: You have potential. I wish you luck in the Orange League.
en: \rCissy: You have potential. I wish you luck in the Orange League.
it: \rCissy: Hai del potenziale. Ti auguro buona fortuna nella Lega Orange.

id: \bCissy has been training on this island for years.
en: \bCissy has been training on this island for years.
it: \bCissy si allena su quest'isola da anni.

id: \bIt's hard to battle when you're swimming.
en: \bIt's hard to battle when you're swimming.
